plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI position to 20% to reduce concentration.
Hold remaining broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) and profitable CRWD.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall risk.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns, targeting around 1.5% per month. The focus is on capital preservation, significantly reducing drawdown risk by eliminating leverage and cutting concentrated positions.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to small positions.
Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration.
Buy SOXS as a hedge against semiconductor weakness.
Maintain exposure to broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) and profitable CRWD.
This plan balances risk reduction with potential for growth.
balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets approximately 2.5% per month by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a tactical inverse ETF. It aims for risk-first growth, with a moderate cash buffer and controlled drawdown potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to reduce concentration.
Add to leveraged AI/Software (METU, MSFU, PLTU), Semiconductor (SOXL, MUU), and Space (SPAL) ETFs.
Buy SOXS as a tactical hedge.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer, accepting higher potential drawdowns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets around 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-conviction sectors and leveraged ETFs. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF rebalancing.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, PLTU, MUU, SPAL) to zero.
Increase QQQI position to 30% for income generation.
Maintain broad index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) for stability.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
It aims for low drawdowns and reliable distributions.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month by prioritizing income-generating ETFs like QQQI and broad index funds. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leverage and high-beta single names, aiming for stable monthly distributions and low drawdowns.
